why: FKT's Holden Village, Holden Pass, Mary Green Glacier toe, then 3rd-4th class rock matches an independent ascent account of the same glacier route.
FKT runs the trail from the Chelan Butte trailhead lot to the summit, and WTA describes the same jeep-road-then-trail ascent to the towers.
FKT and independent guides both use Canyon Creek TH, Jackita Ridge Trail, Crater Lake, then the yellow-X marked gully to the summit plateau, which is the standard route we describe.
The FKT page calls the East Ridge the standard Eldorado route, and Mountaineers/SummitPost describe the same Eldorado Creek, Inspiration Glacier, East Ridge line as ours.

Our route is the same Stuart Lake trailhead nine-peak Enchantment Enchainment the FKT page describes. Independently confirmed: a 2019 CascadeClimbers trip report describes the same nine-peak link-up from Stuart Lake.
The FKT page describes Gerdine Ridge from North Sauk trailhead, which is the Gerdine Ridge/Cool Glacier route from North Fork Sauk via White Pass that Mountain Project describes.

The FKT page follows the Skyline Divide trail and ridge boot path to Hadley with loose scree below the summit, and a trip report confirms the Skyline approach to Chowder Ridge and on to Hadley, matching our route.

The FKT car-to-car line starts at the Eldorado trailhead and crosses the same glaciers and peaks that an independent trip report describes for the Inspiration Traverse, with the same Eldorado approach.

The FKT page and an independent guide both take Denny Creek trail to Melakwa Lake, then the climber's boot path along the ridge south of Kaleetan to the class 3 summit gully, which is our South Ridge.
FKT and an NPS climbing-ranger report both describe Bridge Creek approach, Goode Glacier, then the 4th/easy-5th Northeast Buttress crest.
FKT line from Lake Ann trailhead up the chimneys, Winnie's Slide, Upper Curtis and Hell's Highway matches the NPS ranger description of the Fisher Chimneys route.
